chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Disposer of affairs.

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, loves the servant when He intends good for him, that the angels, the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous pray upon him.
ai.seo_question: Who prays upon a servant when Allah intends good for them?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to illustrate the concept of *Tawfiq* (divine facilitation), where Allah’s intent for a servant’s good is confirmed by the unified intercession of the celestial hierarchy. This collective blessing underscores the Shia understanding of the interconnectedness of the spiritual realms, linking the Prophets, Angels, and the *Siddiqun* in affirming the status of the righteous. It serves as a theological indicator that divine favor is not merely internal but is manifested through the external witness of the *Ahl al-Bayt* and the broader community of believers.
